summary: The filing is an 8-K by Ares Core Infrastructure Fund reporting a monthly closing of unregistered common share sales totaling $313.1 million across three share classes at March 31, 2026 NAV per share ($24.9176). It also discloses NAV and declares regular monthly distributions for April through June 2026. There is no special-situation event; it is a routine periodic disclosure by a registered fund.
